## Business tour to Panama with Ada Tours

We arrange a MICE business tour to [Panama](/panama/): we meet participants arriving on different flights, provide cars and coaches, and coordinate meals and sightseeing with your business schedule. An English-speaking transport coordinator helps with transfers throughout the trip.

Over a week, we will show you [Panama City](/panama/place/panama-city/), take you through [Casco Viejo](/panama/place/casco-viejo/), and arrange a visit to [Miraflores](/panama/place/miraflores-locks/) and a boat expedition from [Gamboa](/panama/place/gamboa/). You can complement your introduction to the country with Geisha coffee and craft beer tastings, lunches and dinners with vegetarian dishes.

### Request a quote for your group

Send us your dates, participant numbers, arrival and meeting schedules, and preferences for transport, assistance and meals. We will put together the services and a tailored quote. We can adapt the seven-day programme below to your schedule.
